subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: After the branch rebases, do the security workflow owners approve these 13 full-SHA action upgrades for the credentialed CI, release, scanning, and Codex workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but third-party actions execute with sensitive tokens or write permissions and repository policy assigns these workflows to an explicit security ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Rebase the branch and approve the grouped update once workflow-sanity, security-sensitive, dependency, CodeQL, Docker, and agent checks pass on that exact head.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: If one action's provenance or runtime behavior remains uncertain, separate the Codex, token, Docker-publishing, or CodeQL updates for isolated review.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Leave the group unmerged if upstream provenance cannot be verified or the rebased security-sensitive workflows do not complete successfully.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch and approve the grouped update once workflow-sanity, security-sensitive, dependency, CodeQL, Docker, and agent checks pass on that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository's CODEOWNERS history directly connects vincentkoc to security workflow review, which is the unresolved decision boundary.
